removed.reason: Mentions ChimayRed exploit for compromising Mikrotik routers, but does not concretely describe exploitation of a client application to execute code; WinBox DLL loading is described as normal behavior by design.
No mention of Windows service control manager or service execution.
No mention of cloud accounts or valid cloud account abuse.
Firmware version is mentioned by researchers, but there is no evidence of adversary system information discovery.
No mention of removable media or Autorun replication.
Registry path for proxy settings is referenced, but the malware reads/searches credentials rather than modifying the registry.
